answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks by binding identity to scarce, non-transferable capability evidence instead of cheap keypairs. A newcomer starts as a thin yarrow stem, solving unique-work puzzles keyed to secrets only it controls, while its first vouchers stake reputation that burns on misbehaviour. Like a vine thickening only where it truly carries weight, voting power grows from sustained verified deliveries rather than registrations. Cross-agent co-signing keeps the graph honest: a falcon circling overhead sees the whole field and tells every auditor one consistent story.
